items.q: What is Smileys Community?
items.a: Smileys is an application-based social community, live in Istanbul, Bodrum and İzmir — and growing city by city. We bring together expats, locals, and globally-minded people through curated events, interest-based clubs, and genuine connections — one account, every Smileys city.

items.q: Who can join?
items.a: Anyone living in or frequently visiting a Smileys city who is open-minded, social, and looking to build real connections. We welcome all nationalities, backgrounds, and lifestyles. The one requirement is that you apply and are approved by our team.

items.q: Is Smileys free to join?
items.a: Applying is completely free. Some events have a ticket price to cover venue or activity costs, but membership itself has no monthly fee.

items.q: How long does approval take?
items.a: Most applications are reviewed within 2–5 business days. You will receive an email once a decision has been made. During busy periods it may take a little longer.

items.q: How do I apply?
items.a: Fill in the application form at smileyscommunity.com/apply. It takes about 5 minutes. Tell us about yourself, what brought you to your city, and what you're looking for in a community.

items.q: What happens after I apply?
items.a: Our team personally reviews every application. If approved, you will receive a welcome email with a link to activate your account. If we need more information, we may reach out before making a decision.

items.q: Why was my application declined?
items.a: We review each application holistically. Common reasons include incomplete answers, a profile that does not seem like a good fit for the current community dynamic, or capacity limits. We do not share specific reasons to protect the integrity of the process.

items.q: Can I reapply after being declined?
items.a: Yes. You are welcome to reapply after 3 months. If your circumstances have changed or you would like to provide more context, a stronger application will always be considered.

items.q: My account was suspended. How do I appeal?
items.a: Submit an appeal at smileyscommunity.com/appeal. Explain your situation and our team will review it. Appeals are typically resolved within 5 business days.

items.q: How do I RSVP to an event?
items.a: Browse upcoming events at smileyscommunity.com/events and click Join on any event that interests you. If the event requires approval, your request will be reviewed by the host.

items.q: What does "approval required" mean?
items.a: Some events are curated and require your request to be manually approved before your spot is confirmed. You will receive a notification once the host reviews your request. Your spot is only confirmed when you see "Approved" status.

items.q: What is the waitlist?
items.a: When an event is full, you will automatically be added to the waitlist. If a spot opens up because someone cancels, the first person on the waitlist is automatically promoted and notified.

items.q: How do I cancel my RSVP?
items.a: Go to the event page and click Cancel. Please cancel as early as possible so your spot can go to someone on the waitlist. Repeated last-minute cancellations may affect your standing.

items.q: Are events gender-balanced?
items.a: Many Smileys events use gender balancing to create a comfortable social dynamic. When spots for one gender are full, additional applicants are added to the waitlist while spots for the other gender may still be available.

items.q: Can I bring a guest?
items.a: Smileys events are for members only unless the event listing specifically states that guests are welcome. This keeps the community feel intact and ensures every attendee has been vetted.

items.q: Do I need to pay to attend events?
items.a: Some events are free, others have a ticket price to cover the venue, food, or activity. The price is always shown clearly on the event page before you RSVP.

items.q: What are clubs?
items.a: Clubs are ongoing interest groups within Smileys — think hiking, photography, dining, language exchange, and more. Each club has its own wall for discussion, a host who organises activities, and a dedicated group of members.

items.q: How do I join a club?
items.a: Browse clubs at smileyscommunity.com/clubs and click Join. Some clubs are open, others require host approval.

items.q: Can I start my own club?
items.a: Yes. If you have a passion or hobby you would like to build a group around, reach out to us via the Contact page. We will review the idea and set you up as a host if it is a good fit for the community.

items.q: What can I post on a club wall?
items.a: Club walls are for sharing updates, organising meetups, asking questions, and keeping the conversation going between events. Polls, pinned announcements, and reactions are all supported.

items.q: How do I update my profile?
items.a: Go to smileyscommunity.com/profile to update your photo, bio, neighbourhood, interests, and contact details.

items.q: How do I change my password?
items.a: Go to your Profile page and scroll to the Change password section. You will need to enter your current password to set a new one.

items.q: How do I change my email address?
items.a: Go to your Profile page, find the Email address section, enter your new email and confirm with your current password. A verification email will be sent to the new address.

items.q: I forgot my password. What do I do?
items.a: Go to smileyscommunity.com/forgot-password and enter your email. We will send you a reset link valid for 24 hours.

items.q: How do I delete my account?
items.a: Please contact us via the Contact page with your request. Account deletion is permanent and removes all your data, event history, and club memberships.

items.q: What are the community guidelines?
items.a: Smileys is built on respect, inclusivity, and genuine connection. We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination, spamming, or any behaviour that makes others feel unsafe or unwelcome. Violation of these principles can result in removal from the community.

items.q: How do I report a member?
items.a: You can report a member from their profile page. Select the reason, add any relevant context, and our moderation team will review it promptly. All reports are confidential.

items.q: Is my personal information safe?
items.a: Yes. We never sell your data to third parties. Your profile is only visible to other verified Smileys members. Read our full Privacy Policy at smileyscommunity.com/privacy for details.

digestSpotlight.title: ⛵ Spending September in Bodrum?
digestSpotlight.body: Smileys is open in Bodrum — founding-stage, which means the first twenty members get to shape it. The guides (18 of them), neighborhoods, and clubs are ready; what is missing is you. If you summer on the peninsula, know someone who lives there year-round, or you are the kind of person who would rather start a table than find one — this is your moment. One account works in every Smileys city.

digestSpotlight.title: 🌊 Smileys İzmir is open
digestSpotlight.body: Our third city went live this week — founding-stage, which means the first twenty members get to shape it. The neighborhoods are mapped from Alsancak to Alaçatı, three clubs are forming, and the city guide is being written right now. If you live on the bay, know someone who does, or you are the kind of person who would rather start a table than find one — this is your moment. One account works in every Smileys city.

digestSpotlight.title: 🌅 Fifteen people in Antalya, and no first dinner yet
digestSpotlight.body: Smileys Antalya has fifteen members, a city guide and three clubs — and has never once had everyone in the same room. We're fixing that this month with a first coffee in Kaleiçi. If you live on that coast, winter there, or you're the sort who'd rather start a table than find one, this is the moment to be early: the first twenty members shape what the city becomes. One account works in every Smileys city.

digestSpotlight.title: 🏛️ Smileys Ankara is open
digestSpotlight.body: The capital joined this week — eighteen neighbourhoods from Ulus to Kızılcahamam, fifteen places worth your Saturday, and an honest guide to the Başkentkart. Founding-stage, which means the first twenty members decide what it becomes. If you're in Ankara, back and forth for work, or you know the person who is, this is the moment. One account works in every Smileys city.
